Alibaba Expands AI Infrastructure with New Data Centers and Chip

Alibaba is expanding its artificial intelligence infrastructure by adding data centers in Europe and the Middle East. The company is also developing a larger AI model and a new chip to support its AI initiatives. This expansion aims to bolster Alibaba's presence in the growing AI market.
